page_title: NIC 2-2 LIL | Nice v Lille 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' 2 - 2 Tom Louchet (Nice) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
90+5' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Angel Gomes (Lille) for his blatant foul.
90+3' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A spell of possession for Nice in an attempt to control the game.
86' Yellow card. Jonathan David (Lille) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
85' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
85' Ali Abdi (Nice) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
84' Victor Orakpo (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jeremie Boga.
83' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle after Tom Louchet (Nice) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
81' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was!
80' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo is replaced by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille).
79' Substitution. Edon Zhegrova leaves the pitch and is replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).

77' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Ali Abdi (Nice) inside the box and he manages to steer it low to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Lucas Chevalier makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
76' There's an opportunity for Sofiane Diop (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
75' Here is a change. Mohamed-Ali Cho is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
75' That will be all from Pablo Rosario who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
75' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

74' A nice lofted cross finds Jonathan David (Lille) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Jonathan David (Lille) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save. Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
73' 5:1 – the corner kicks stats.
70' A clumsy foul by Alexsandro (Lille) and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle.
67' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Angel Gomes (Lille) replaces Ayyoub Bouaddi.
66' 1 - 2 Mitchel Bakker (Lille) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes the ball into the roof of the net. What a lovely finish!
66' A great pass puts Benjamin Andre (Lille) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
65' Some great controlled play and passing from Lille. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
62' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Tanguy Ndombele as he is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
62' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) takes it short.
59' Ball possession – 38:62.
56' 1 - 1 Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
53' A rebound falls to Jeremie Boga (Nice) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
52' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
51' Nice hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
47' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Franck Haise makes a switch. Sofiane Diop is coming on in place of Melvin Bard (Nice) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:0.
41' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
38' Bafode Diakite (Lille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
37' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
34' Lille string together a series of short passes.

31' Jeremie Boga (Nice) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Lucas Chevalier, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
29' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
29' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Nice are awarded a corner kick.
28' Nice are ruled offside.
26' The ball is cleared after Jonathan David (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' The total number of attempts is 0:4.
20' Nice keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

17' 0 - 1 Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Marcin Bulka is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
15' Nice are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
12' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 30:70.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
7' Some neat passing and movement from Lille as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
5' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
4' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) picks up a long through ball, but Lucas Chevalier deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
3' Jonathan David (Lille) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
